scenes.event: Waiting for a response from Professor Leo
scenes.description: Victor sits on a library sofa, nervously checking his phone for a reply from Professor Leo. His friend Kimi is nearby, sitting on a chair beside him, while his roommate Jack leans against a nearby bookshelf. The atmosphere is tense as Victor's indecision about his major weighs on the conversation.

characters.name: Victor Kim
characters.description: A 17-year-old college sophomore who is deeply contemplative and anxious about his future. characters.description: Victor's close friend who is optimistic and action-oriented; Female; Age: 20; Occupation: Psychology major and part-time campus counselor intern; Personality: Energetic, empathetic, determined; Values: Personal growth, loyalty, decisiveness; Interests: Mental health advocacy, hiking, true crime podcasts; Experiences: Volunteered at a youth mentorship program, declared her major at 18 after extensive research, recently helped Victor navigate academic stress.
characters.position: Sitting beside Victor on the chair

characters.name: Jack
characters.description: Victor's roommate who is pragmatic and prefers direct communication; Male; Age: 21; Occupation: Computer Science major; Personality: Calm, direct, encouraging; Values: Efficiency, honesty, personal responsibility; Interests: Coding, problem-solving, fitness; Experiences: Helped Victor navigate academic decisions in the past, worked part-time as a tutor for introductory programming courses.

actions.dialogue: Hey Victor, do you think Professor Leo will reply soon? You seem really anxious.
I don’t know. I hope he does. I just… I’m not sure which major I should go for. Both Math and Finance seem so different.
Why don’t you just go to his office and talk to him in person? Sometimes you need to take the initiative to get the clarity you're looking for.
That’s not a bad idea, Jack. I just don’t want to seem unsure to him. I want to make the right decision, you know?
You don’t have to have it all figured out, Victor. Professors are used to students being uncertain. What matters is that you’re trying to find your direction.

scenes.plot: Victor is waiting for a reply from Professor Leo about a potential mentorship opportunity. His friends, Kimi and Jack, notice his anxiety and offer advice. Kimi encourages him to accept that uncertainty is normal, while Jack pushes for a more proactive approach. Victor begins to consider visiting the professor in person to discuss his major decision, which could lead to a breakthrough in his academic planning.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Victor’s internal struggle about choosing a major and how his values of academic success and clear direction influence his decision-making. His interactions with Kimi and Jack reveal his personality traits of hesitation and curiosity, as well as his reliance on friendship for support.
